free_tier.stated: No free sandbox quota or trial credit is published: sandboxes run on Nirvana-provisioned sandbox clusters that the customer creates and is billed for. Compute is $0.016 per vCPU-hour and $0.004 per GB of RAM per hour, so a 2 vCPU, 4 GB n1-highcpu-2 instance is $0.048 per hour (the registered list's $0.048/h figure), with storage and egress billed separately.
free_tier.notes: The $0.048/h is the n1-highcpu-2 list price on the vendor pricing page (2 vCPU, 4 GB, 0.5 Gbps) and equals 2 x $0.016 + 4 x $0.004. This is the instance cost; a sandbox cluster's nodes, persistent volumes and external egress add to the bill. No introductory credit is stated on the pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a container sandbox with an optional persistent volume claim, not an object

retention.stated: an ephemeral sandbox's filesystem is lost when the sandbox is deleted; a persistent volume claim can be mounted into a sandbox and reused by a later sandbox on the same cluster with the same claimName, and deleting the cluster deletes all PVCs and their data

egress.terms: External egress is $0.02 per GB at one flat rate; ingress and transfers between Nirvana IPs are free. Sandbox ports are reached through signed, expiring endpoints on the cluster gateway, valid up to 24 hours.
egress.free_allowance: transfers between Nirvana IPs are free

interface_detail: OpenSandbox-compatible Sandbox Lifecycle API at https://api.nirvanalabs.io/v1/sandboxes with OpenSandbox SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, Java and Kotlin, plus plain HTTP; the Homebrew-installable CLI, Terraform provider, MCP server and Go/TypeScript SDKs manage clusters.
tooling: OpenSandbox SDKs (TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, Java, Kotlin) with base URL https://api.nirvanalabs.io/v1, the nirvana CLI, Terraform provider, @nirvana-labs/nirvana-mcp and the Go/TypeScript SDKs.
chaining: Scoped organization API keys let an agent create and drive sandboxes with least privilege, mount a persistent PVC to keep checkpoints across sandbox restarts, and reach in-sandbox services through signed gateway endpoints; the same keys drive the VMs, storage and NKS clusters around the sandbox.

limits.value: sandbox cluster node_count 1 to 100; an organization can run any number of clusters within its quotas; signed endpoints expire with the sandbox or after 1 hour, never lasting more than 24 hours
every endpoint requires an organization API key as a bearer token; only dashboard owners can see or create keys, and members cannot create, update or delete sandbox clusters or sandboxes

binding_note: Reaching the offer first requires an organization API key obtainable only from a dashboard owner; once a cluster exists the per-hour compute meter is the next constraint. A plain read without a key returns HTTP 401.

identity_cost.detail: institution: the only credential the authentication page names is an organization API key, issued from https://dashboard.nirvanalabs.io/ by an organization owner; members cannot see or create keys. The sign-up route returned an error page ('Couldn’t sign in. If you are not sure what happened, please contact your organization admin.'), so the identity required to register is unverified: no capture shows that email, phone, card, ID document or institution is the sign-up gate.

reliability_note: Agent Sandboxes is an early-release product. Deleting a sandbox cluster deletes every sandbox, all its PVCs and their data with no recovery; signed endpoints expire, by default with the sandbox or after 1 hour, and never last more than 24 hours.
confidence_note: The sandbox model, API, persistence, endpoint expiry and authentication gate are quoted from first-party product documentation read on 2026-11-25; the compute and egress rates are quoted from the vendor's own pricing text, and the $0.048/h comparison from the registered list.

notes: Hosted isolated agent sandboxes on Nirvana-provisioned clusters, with an OpenSandbox-compatible API and optional persistent volumes. There is no published free tier, so the offer is paid-only; pricing is per vCPU-hour and per GB of RAM per hour with egress at $0.02 per GB. Every API call needs an organization API key created by a dashboard owner; the sign-up route could not be read, so its registration identity is unverified.
